correctness.rationale: Conjugation by total permutations identifies rank-r sandwich variants with partial identity e_R. A partial injection f is sandwich-nilpotent iff its functional digraph has no directed cycle contained wholly in R: an arbitrarily long alternating f-e_R walk forces a repeated R vertex. Inclusion-exclusion over disjoint cycles on t≤r vertices has signed weight sum_{π∈S_t}(-1)^cycles =0 for t≥2, so only t=0 and t=1 remain and N_{n,r,k}=C(n,k)^2 k!(1-rk/n²). For uniform partial injection J=n-rank, w_{n,j+1}/w_{n,j}=(n-j)/(j+1)^2 and exact E[J(J+1)]=n; geometric-tail concentration yields J/sqrt(n)→1, uniform integrability yields E[J]/sqrt(n)→1. Thus P→1-ρ and sqrt(n)P_{n,n-s_n}→1+τ. Independent n≤5 exhaustive sandwich-power enumeration and exact J moments corroborate, not replace, all-n proof.
